style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red.
avoid_en: logos or emblems of real companies or government agencies, readable text, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people, guns pointed at the viewer

chapo.desc_en: the drug lord, a short stocky faceless man figurine in his fifties with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short black hair, a thick black mustache shape, plain black baseball cap without any logo, plain dark-blue button shirt, dark jeans

tech.desc_en: the technician, a slim faceless young man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short neat brown hair, thin black-rimmed glasses, plain light-blue shirt without any print, gray trousers

agents.desc_en: investigator figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain navy windbreakers with no letters, patches or badges, gray trousers

marines.desc_en: marine figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain dark gray-green uniforms with no patches, flags or letters, plain black helmets, weapons always pointed down

cuts.image: 白い空間に置かれた、海辺の白い大きな屋敷の模型。門の前に灰色の制服の警察官のフィギュアが並ぶ
cuts.image_en: A miniature large white seaside villa with palm trees and a pool in the white space; a line of faceless police figurines in plain gray uniforms without badges stands at the gate. Early morning light.
cuts.en: A miniature large white seaside villa with palm trees and a pool in the white space; a line of faceless police figurines in plain gray uniforms without badges stands at the gate. Early morning light.

cuts.image: 屋敷の模型の中の部屋。椅子の上に黒い帽子だけが残り、誰もいない
cuts.image_en: Inside the villa diorama, an empty elegant room; only a plain black baseball cap is left on a chair. Nobody there. Quiet, missed-by-minutes mood.
cuts.en: Inside the villa diorama, an empty elegant room; only a plain black baseball cap is left on a chair. Nobody there. Quiet, missed-by-minutes mood.

cuts.image: 白い空間に置かれた、ふつうの住宅街の模型。その中の1軒だけが赤く照らされている
cuts.image_en: A miniature ordinary Mexican city neighborhood diorama of low concrete houses in the white space; one house in the middle is lit with a red glow. Before dawn.
cuts.en: A miniature ordinary Mexican city neighborhood diorama of low concrete houses in the white space; one house in the middle is lit with a red glow. Before dawn.

cuts.image: 家の模型の前で、黒いヘルメットの海軍の兵士のフィギュアが、分厚い鉄の扉を開けようとしている
cuts.image_en: In front of the house diorama, marine figurines push against a thick reinforced steel door that will not open, one holding a battering ram. No weapons pointed at viewer, no flags.
cuts.en: In front of the house diorama, marine figurines push against a thick reinforced steel door that will not open, one holding a battering ram. No weapons pointed at viewer, no flags.

cuts.image: 家の中の模型。誰もいない部屋で、テレビの模型と椅子だけが残っている
cuts.image_en: Inside the house diorama, an empty living room with a plain dark TV, a sofa and an overturned chair. Nobody there. Gray morning light.
cuts.en: Inside the house diorama, an empty living room with a plain dark TV, a sofa and an overturned chair. Nobody there. Gray morning light.

cuts.image: 浴室の模型。白い浴槽が斜めに持ち上がり、その下に暗い階段が見えている
cuts.image_en: A small white tiled bathroom diorama: the white bathtub is raised up on hydraulic arms, tilted, revealing a dark concrete stairway going down underneath it. Dramatic light from below.
cuts.en: A small white tiled bathroom diorama: the white bathtub is raised up on hydraulic arms, tilted, revealing a dark concrete stairway going down underneath it. Dramatic light from below.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、町の模型の断面。地下に下水道の管が網のように通り、小さな人影が遠くへ進んでいる
cuts.image_en: A cross-section diorama of a city: houses on the surface, and below them a network of concrete sewer tunnels; one tiny dark figure moves far away along a tunnel. No water splashes.
cuts.en: A cross-section diorama of a city: houses on the surface, and below them a network of concrete sewer tunnels; one tiny dark figure moves far away along a tunnel. No water splashes.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、黒いTシャツの大柄な男のフィギュアが、小さな携帯の画面を見ている。画面から赤い電波の輪が広がる
cuts.image_en: A large faceless bodyguard figurine in a plain black t-shirt looks down at a small phone in his hand; red radio-wave rings spread out from the phone. White space.
cuts.en: A large faceless bodyguard figurine in a plain black t-shirt looks down at a small phone in his hand; red radio-wave rings spread out from the phone. White space.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、海岸線の地図の模型。赤い点線が北から海辺の町の1点へのび、赤いピンが刺さる
cuts.image_en: A plain relief map model of a Pacific coastline in the white space; a red dotted line runs down the coast and ends at one red pin in a seaside town. No text, no flags.
cuts.en: A plain relief map model of a Pacific coastline in the white space; a red dotted line runs down the coast and ends at one red pin in a seaside town. No text, no flags.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、海辺の12階建ての白いマンションの模型。4階の窓が1つだけ明るい
cuts.image_en: A miniature twelve-story white beachfront condominium tower beside a small strip of beach in the white space; only one window on the fourth floor is lit. Pre-dawn blue light. No signs.
cuts.en: A miniature twelve-story white beachfront condominium tower beside a small strip of beach in the white space; only one window on the fourth floor is lit. Pre-dawn blue light. No signs.

cuts.image: マンションの模型の廊下。黒いヘルメットの兵士のフィギュアが、401号室の扉の前に並んでいる
cuts.image_en: A narrow hallway diorama inside the condominium; marine figurines line up quietly beside an apartment door. Weapons pointed down. Pre-dawn light. No numbers or signs readable.
cuts.en: A narrow hallway diorama inside the condominium; marine figurines line up quietly beside an apartment door. Weapons pointed down. Pre-dawn light. No numbers or signs readable.

cuts.image: 部屋の模型の床に、黒い帽子の男のフィギュアがひざをつき、まわりを兵士のフィギュアが囲む
cuts.image_en: Inside a small apartment diorama, the drug lord figurine kneels on the floor with his hands behind his head, surrounded by marine figurines. Calm, no blood, no injuries.
cuts.en: Inside a small apartment diorama, the drug lord figurine kneels on the floor with his hands behind his head, surrounded by marine figurines. Calm, no blood, no injuries.

cuts.image_en: A large gray maximum-security prison diorama in the white space, surrounded by high double walls and watchtowers, seen from above. Flat open land around it. No flags.
cuts.en: A large gray maximum-security prison diorama in the white space, surrounded by high double walls and watchtowers, seen from above. Flat open land around it. No flags.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、見張りの画面の模型が並ぶ。真ん中の画面だけ、空っぽの独房を映している
cuts.image_en: A wall of small plain security monitor models in the white space; the center screen shows an empty grey prison cell with a small shower corner. No text on screens.
cuts.en: A wall of small plain security monitor models in the white space; the center screen shows an empty grey prison cell with a small shower corner. No text on screens.

cuts.image: 独房の模型。低い仕切りの奥のシャワーの所に、黒い帽子の男の後ろ姿が消えかけている
cuts.image_en: A small prison cell diorama seen from above; the drug lord figurine (without his cap, short black hair) is stepping behind a low concrete partition into the shower corner, only his back visible.
cuts.en: A small prison cell diorama seen from above; the drug lord figurine (without his cap, short black hair) is stepping behind a low concrete partition into the shower corner, only his back visible.

cuts.image: シャワーの床の模型に、四角い穴。穴の下へ、はしごが続いている
cuts.image_en: A close view of a tiled shower floor diorama with a neat square hole cut into it; a metal ladder goes down into darkness. Light from below.
cuts.en: A close view of a tiled shower floor diorama with a neat square hole cut into it; a metal ladder goes down into darkness. Light from below.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、地面の断面の模型。刑務所から遠くの小さな建物まで、細いトンネルが長く伸びている
cuts.image_en: A long cross-section diorama of the ground: on the left a prison building, on the far right a small unfinished brick house, connected underground by one very long thin tunnel. Clean, wide view.
cuts.en: A long cross-section diorama of the ground: on the left a prison building, on the far right a small unfinished brick house, connected underground by one very long thin tunnel. Clean, wide view.

cuts.image: 狭いトンネルの模型の中。天井に小さな電球、壁に管、床に細いレール
cuts.image_en: Inside a narrow dirt tunnel diorama, seen from one end: small light bulbs along the ceiling, a plastic air pipe along the wall, thin metal rails on the floor vanishing into the distance.
cuts.en: Inside a narrow dirt tunnel diorama, seen from one end: small light bulbs along the ceiling, a plastic air pipe along the wall, thin metal rails on the floor vanishing into the distance.

cuts.image: トンネルの模型の中のレールの上に、小さな台車をつけた古いバイクの模型が置かれている
cuts.image_en: Inside the narrow tunnel diorama, an old small motorcycle modified to run on the thin rails, attached to a small flat cart. Nobody on it. Dim bulbs.
cuts.en: Inside the narrow tunnel diorama, an old small motorcycle modified to run on the thin rails, attached to a small flat cart. Nobody on it. Dim bulbs.

cuts.image: 白い空間に置かれた、海に近い平らな町の模型。夜明け前の暗い青
cuts.image_en: A flat coastal Mexican town diorama of low houses and straight streets in the white space, in dark pre-dawn blue light. No signs.
cuts.en: A flat coastal Mexican town diorama of low houses and straight streets in the white space, in dark pre-dawn blue light. No signs.

cuts.image: 町の模型の1軒の家を、兵士のフィギュアが取り囲んでいる。窓から白い光がもれている
cuts.image_en: Marine figurines surround one house in the town diorama, crouching behind a plain truck; bright white light flashes from the windows. No blood, no fire.
cuts.en: Marine figurines surround one house in the town diorama, crouching behind a plain truck; bright white light flashes from the windows. No blood, no fire.

cuts.image: 町の模型の道路の上を、1台の小さな灰色の車が走っていく。後ろにマンホールが開いている
cuts.image_en: A small plain gray car speeding along a straight town road diorama; behind it an open manhole on the road. The drug lord figurine is barely visible in the driver seat. Early morning.
cuts.en: A small plain gray car speeding along a straight town road diorama; behind it an open manhole on the road. The drug lord figurine is barely visible in the driver seat. Early morning.

cuts.image: 道路の模型で、灰色の車の前に白い警察の車が止まり、制服の警官のフィギュアが立っている
cuts.image_en: On a highway diorama, a plain white police car blocks the small gray car; faceless police figurines in plain dark uniforms without badges stand beside it. No text on the car.
cuts.en: On a highway diorama, a plain white police car blocks the small gray car; faceless police figurines in plain dark uniforms without badges stand beside it. No text on the car.

cuts.image: 道の模型で、黒い帽子の男のフィギュアが札束を差し出し、警官のフィギュアが手を横に振っている
cuts.image_en: On the road diorama, the drug lord figurine holds out a bundle of plain green banknotes toward a police figurine, who raises a hand in refusal. Clear gesture.
cuts.en: On the road diorama, the drug lord figurine holds out a bundle of plain green banknotes toward a police figurine, who raises a hand in refusal. Clear gesture.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、夜の滑走路の模型。白い小さな飛行機に、両側を人に囲まれた男のフィギュアが乗り込む
cuts.image_en: A night airport runway diorama in the white space; a small plain white jet with no markings, and a figurine in a plain gray outfit being escorted up the stairs by investigator figurines. Floodlights.
cuts.en: A night airport runway diorama in the white space; a small plain white jet with no markings, and a figurine in a plain gray outfit being escorted up the stairs by investigator figurines. Floodlights.

cuts.image: 法廷の模型の証人の席に、メガネの技術者のフィギュアが座っている
cuts.image_en: Inside the courtroom diorama, the technician figurine sits in the witness box, hands folded, a single plain microphone in front of him.
cuts.en: Inside the courtroom diorama, the technician figurine sits in the witness box, hands folded, a single plain microphone in front of him.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、画板の模型。描きかけの人の絵の顔の所だけが、白く空いている
cuts.image_en: A sketch board on an easel in the white space with an unfinished pencil drawing of a seated man; the face area is left completely blank white. No writing.
cuts.en: A sketch board on an easel in the white space with an unfinished pencil drawing of a seated man; the face area is left completely blank white. No writing.

cuts.image: 法廷の模型の被告の席に黒いスーツの背の低い男のフィギュア。前のスピーカーの模型から赤い音の波
cuts.image_en: Inside the courtroom diorama, the drug lord figurine in a plain dark suit (no cap) sits at the defense table; red sound-wave rings come from a speaker in front of the jury.
cuts.en: Inside the courtroom diorama, the drug lord figurine in a plain dark suit (no cap) sits at the defense table; red sound-wave rings come from a speaker in front of the jury.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、2つの音の波の形の模型が上下に並び、形がぴったり重なっている

cuts.en: Two red sound-wave shapes made of thin bent wire, one above the other in the white space, matching each other perfectly. Clean, symbolic.

cuts.image: 法廷の模型の大きな画面に、吹き出しの形がいくつも並んでいる（文字は読めない）
cuts.image_en: A large screen in the courtroom diorama showing many blank speech-bubble shapes in a chat layout, no readable text; small juror figurines look at it.
cuts.en: A large screen in the courtroom diorama showing many blank speech-bubble shapes in a chat layout, no readable text; small juror figurines look at it.

cuts.image: 法廷の模型の上から見た裁判官の席。小槌が振り下ろされる
cuts.image_en: A view from above of the judge's bench in the courtroom diorama, a wooden gavel coming down onto its block. Strong light.
cuts.en: A view from above of the judge's bench in the courtroom diorama, a wooden gavel coming down onto its block. Strong light.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、大きな札束の山の輪郭だけが白い線で描かれ、中身は空っぽ
cuts.image_en: A large outline of a mountain of banknote bundles drawn with thin white wire in the white space, but the inside is completely empty. Symbolic.
cuts.en: A large outline of a mountain of banknote bundles drawn with thin white wire in the white space, but the inside is completely empty. Symbolic.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、山のふもとの低いコンクリートの刑務所の模型。雪の山
cuts.image_en: A low gray concrete prison complex model at the foot of snowy mountains in the white space, surrounded by fences. Cold, isolated mood. No flags.
cuts.en: A low gray concrete prison complex model at the foot of snowy mountains in the white space, surrounded by fences. Cold, isolated mood. No flags.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、2つの模型が並ぶ。左は携帯電話、右は白い警察の車
cuts.image_en: Two small separate models side by side in the white space: on the left a plain small phone with red radio-wave rings, on the right a plain white police car with no markings.
cuts.en: Two small separate models side by side in the white space: on the left a plain small phone with red radio-wave rings, on the right a plain white police car with no markings.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、大きな金庫の扉の模型が開き、中から白い光がもれている。扉の前に赤い鍵
cuts.image_en: A big round steel vault door standing wide open in the white space, white light pouring out from inside; a large red key lies on the floor in front of it.
cuts.en: A big round steel vault door standing wide open in the white space, white light pouring out from inside; a large red key lies on the floor in front of it.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、今のスマホの模型が並び、そのうち1台の画面に小さな赤い目のしるし
cuts.image_en: A row of modern plain smartphones (no logos) standing in the white space; on one of them glows a small red eye-shaped symbol. Clean product-shot style.
cuts.en: A row of modern plain smartphones (no logos) standing in the white space; on one of them glows a small red eye-shaped symbol. Clean product-shot style.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、ふつうの服の人のフィギュアの手から、別の人の手へ、スマホが渡されている
cuts.image_en: A plain modern smartphone being handed from one faceless figurine in casual clothes to another. Everyday mood, white space.
cuts.en: A plain modern smartphone being handed from one faceless figurine in casual clothes to another. Everyday mood, white space.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、スマホの模型と、虫めがねの模型
cuts.image_en: A plain modern smartphone lying on the white floor with a large magnifying glass hovering over it. Clean, calm.
cuts.en: A plain modern smartphone lying on the white floor with a large magnifying glass hovering over it. Clean, calm.
